def recursive(n, pos, base):
    total = (pos + 1) * (n // base[pos])
    n %= base[pos]
    if n == 0:
        return total
    option1 = recursive(n, pos - 1, base)
    option2 = (pos + 1) + recursive(base[pos] - n, pos - 1, base)
    return total + min(option1, option2)
